name: Housing Authority of the City of Long Beach
serves: the City of Long Beach, California
intro: The Housing Authority of the City of Long Beach (HACLB) runs Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers for the City of Long Beach, California. It is a voucher-only agency: HUD's PHA contact report lists Long Beach (CA068) with a program type of "Section 8," and HACLB's own program pages list vouchers, Shelter Plus Care, VASH and project-based voucher apartments, but no public housing of its own. That distinction matters more than it sounds, because the largest public housing community inside Long Beach city limits is not HACLB's at all. Its waiting lists, run by Los Angeles County, were open from August 17 to September 16, 2026 and are closed now, like HACLB's. This page summarizes what HACLB itself publishes about its waiting-list status, contact information and how to apply, explains the Carmelitos exception, and links to the official pages for anything time-sensitive.
programs: Shelter Plus Care and homeless assistance
Emergency Housing Voucher (HUD has notified HACLB that it is ending this program)

waitlists.note: Closed with no reopening scheduled (checked September 21, 2026). HACLB's notice reads: "The Housing Authority of the City of Long Beach's waiting list is currently closed, and no openings are scheduled at this time." Its application page adds: "At this time, our waiting lists are closed. When the lists reopen, we will share more information on our website and social media." That page also offers a mailing list you can join so HACLB can tell you directly when the lists reopen.

waitlists.program: Carmelitos public housing, in Long Beach but run by Los Angeles County
waitlists.note: This is not an HACLB list, but it is public housing inside Long Beach. The Los Angeles County Development Authority (LACDA) took registrations for its 16 site-based waiting lists from August 17, 2026 until 5:00 p.m. on September 16, 2026, and two of them are Carmelitos Senior (155 units, Long Beach) and Carmelitos Family (558 units, Long Beach). LACDA's page now reads "WAITING LISTS FOR ELDERLY AND GENERAL OCCUPANCY PUBLIC HOUSING SITES ARE CLOSED" and "The waiting list application period closed on September 16, 2026, at 5:00 p.m.," and its registration portal, harp.lacda.org, reads "ALL PUBLIC HOUSING WAITING LISTS ARE NOW CLOSED" (checked September 21, 2026). LACDA gives no date for the next opening. For questions, LACDA's line is (626) 586-1522.

waitlists.program: Los Angeles County Development Authority Section 8
waitlists.note: LACDA's site-based waiting list page states: "The County's Section 8 waiting list also remains closed." Its registration portal adds: "MULTIFAMILY PROGRAM WAITING LISTS ARE NOW CLOSED!" (checked September 21, 2026).

waitlists.program: Privately owned affordable apartments in Long Beach
waitlists.note: HACLB publishes a listing of privately owned affordable housing and says "Each facility maintains its own independent waiting list" and "You may register on as many waiting lists as you wish." You apply to each building directly; HACLB does not take those applications and cannot tell you your position on them.

also_serving: The Los Angeles County Development Authority (LACDA) is a separate agency, and Long Beach sits outside most of its territory on purpose. LACDA says it "serves the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County (areas that are not part of a city) and 62 incorporated cities," and it names Long Beach as one of 18 cities in the county that run their own public housing agency. Main line (626) 262-4511.

The one exception is Carmelitos, and it is a large one. LACDA states that it "has a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Long Beach Housing Authority to permit residents of the City of Long Beach to be classified as in-jurisdiction applicants for housing at the Carmelitos Public Housing development only." Carmelitos is in Long Beach, and its two site-based lists cover 155 senior units and 558 family units. Those lists were open from August 17 to September 16, 2026 and are closed now. HACLB's home page did carry a news item about the county's opening, "Los Angeles County Public Housing Waiting List is Open. Applications accepted 8/17/2026 - 9/16/2026," but it does not name Carmelitos, so watch lacda.org for the next opening.

HUD is ending the Emergency Housing Voucher program. HACLB's home page states: "The U.S. Department of Housing of Urban Development has notified us that they are ending the Emergency Housing Voucher program." HACLB had been allocated 582 of these vouchers through the American Rescue Plan Act. If you hold one, call HACLB at (562) 570-6985 and ask what the wind-down means for your household rather than waiting for a letter.

HACLB is appointment-only. Its office at 1500 Hughes Way, Suite C-300 is open Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday from 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. and Thursday from 7:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., and it asks you to "schedule an appointment in advance by calling (562) 570-6985." A drop box is available Monday through Friday, 4:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., and the waiting-list mailbox is HA-WaitingList@longbeach.gov.

faqs.q: Is the Long Beach Section 8 waiting list open?
faqs.a: No. As of September 21, 2026 the Housing Authority of the City of Long Beach states that its "waiting list is currently closed, and no openings are scheduled at this time." There is no announced reopening date. HACLB says it will share the news on its website and social media when the lists reopen, and its application page offers a mailing list you can join. Confirm at longbeach.gov/haclb/apply or call (562) 570-6985 before you rely on this.

faqs.q: Does Long Beach have public housing?
faqs.a: Not through HACLB. HUD's PHA contact report lists the City of Long Beach Housing Authority (CA068) with a program type of "Section 8," and HACLB's program pages list only voucher-based programs. But Carmelitos, a large public housing community inside Long Beach, is owned by the Los Angeles County Development Authority. Its senior and family waiting lists were open from August 17 to September 16, 2026 and are closed now: LACDA's page reads "The waiting list application period closed on September 16, 2026, at 5:00 p.m." (checked September 21, 2026). If you want public housing in Long Beach, Carmelitos is still the place to watch, and LACDA has not given a date for its next opening.

faqs.q: Can I apply for Carmelitos if I live in Long Beach?
faqs.a: Yes, whenever LACDA opens the Carmelitos lists, and you are treated as a local applicant. LACDA states that it "has a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Long Beach Housing Authority to permit residents of the City of Long Beach to be classified as in-jurisdiction applicants for housing at the Carmelitos Public Housing development only." The most recent registration ran from August 17 to September 16, 2026 and is closed; LACDA's registration portal, harp.lacda.org, now reads "ALL PUBLIC HOUSING WAITING LISTS ARE NOW CLOSED" (checked September 21, 2026). For questions, call LACDA at (626) 586-1522.

faqs.q: What number should I call at the Long Beach Housing Authority?
faqs.a: (562) 570-6985. That is the number on HACLB's contact page and the one HUD lists for CA068, and HACLB asks you to use it to book an appointment before visiting. Several teams have their own direct lines: moves and portability (562) 570-5242, rent increases and owner questions (562) 570-5372, and inspections (562) 570-5340. Note that the (562) 570-4500 number that appears on the housing authority landing page belongs to the city's homelessness and housing services, not to HACLB itself.

faqs.q: I have an Emergency Housing Voucher. What happens now?
faqs.a: HACLB has published that "The U.S. Department of Housing of Urban Development has notified us that they are ending the Emergency Housing Voucher program," and points readers to longbeach.gov/ehv for details. HACLB received 582 EHVs under the American Rescue Plan Act. HACLB has not published a household-level timeline, so call (562) 570-6985 and ask specifically what the end of the program means for your assistance and your lease, and get the answer in writing.

faqs.q: How will I find out when HACLB reopens its list?
faqs.a: HACLB says it will announce it on its website and social media, and its application page offers a mailing list sign-up. Because the reopening is not scheduled, it is worth setting your own reminder to check longbeach.gov/haclb every few weeks rather than waiting to see it. In the meantime, the privately owned affordable buildings on HACLB's list each keep their own waiting list you can join at any time. The Carmelitos public housing lists that Los Angeles County opened on August 17, 2026 closed on September 16, 2026.

es.serves: la ciudad de Long Beach, California
es.intro: La Autoridad de Vivienda de la Ciudad de Long Beach (HACLB) administra los vales de la Sección 8 (Housing Choice Voucher) para la ciudad de Long Beach, California. Es una agencia que solo maneja vales: el informe de contactos de PHA de HUD clasifica a Long Beach (CA068) como programa de "Section 8", y las propias páginas de HACLB enumeran vales, Shelter Plus Care, VASH y apartamentos con vales basados en proyecto, pero ninguna vivienda pública propia. Esa distinción importa más de lo que parece, porque la comunidad de vivienda pública más grande dentro de los límites de Long Beach no es de HACLB. Sus listas de espera, del condado de Los Ángeles, estuvieron abiertas del 17 de agosto al 16 de septiembre de 2026 y ahora están cerradas, igual que las de HACLB. Esta página resume lo que HACLB publica sobre el estado de su lista de espera, su información de contacto y cómo solicitar, explica la excepción de Carmelitos y enlaza a las páginas oficiales para cualquier dato que cambie con el tiempo.
programs: Shelter Plus Care y asistencia para personas sin hogar
Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing (VASH), para veteranos
Apartamentos con vales basados en proyecto (Project Based Voucher)
Emergency Housing Voucher (HUD notificó a HACLB que va a terminar este programa)

waitlists.note: Cerrada y sin fecha de reapertura (verificado el 21 de septiembre de 2026). El aviso de HACLB dice: "The Housing Authority of the City of Long Beach's waiting list is currently closed, and no openings are scheduled at this time" (la lista de espera está cerrada y no hay aperturas programadas). Su página de solicitud añade: "At this time, our waiting lists are closed. When the lists reopen, we will share more information on our website and social media" (cuando las listas reabran, lo anunciaremos en nuestro sitio web y redes sociales). Esa misma página ofrece una lista de correo a la que puede inscribirse para que HACLB le avise directamente.

waitlists.program: Vivienda pública de Carmelitos, en Long Beach pero administrada por el condado de Los Ángeles
waitlists.status: Cerrada desde el 16 de septiembre de 2026
waitlists.note: Esta no es una lista de HACLB, pero es vivienda pública dentro de Long Beach. La Los Angeles County Development Authority (LACDA) recibió inscripciones para sus 16 listas de espera por sitio desde el 17 de agosto de 2026 hasta las 5:00 p.m. del 16 de septiembre de 2026, y dos de ellas son Carmelitos Senior (155 unidades, Long Beach) y Carmelitos Family (558 unidades, Long Beach). La página de LACDA ahora dice "WAITING LISTS FOR ELDERLY AND GENERAL OCCUPANCY PUBLIC HOUSING SITES ARE CLOSED" (las listas de vivienda pública para personas mayores y de ocupación general están cerradas) y "The waiting list application period closed on September 16, 2026, at 5:00 p.m." (el período de solicitud cerró el 16 de septiembre de 2026 a las 5:00 p.m.), y su portal de inscripción, harp.lacda.org, dice "ALL PUBLIC HOUSING WAITING LISTS ARE NOW CLOSED" (todas las listas de vivienda pública están cerradas). Verificado el 21 de septiembre de 2026. LACDA no da fecha para la próxima apertura. Para preguntas, la línea de LACDA es el (626) 586-1522.

waitlists.program: Sección 8 de la Los Angeles County Development Authority
waitlists.note: La página de listas de espera por sitio de LACDA dice: "The County's Section 8 waiting list also remains closed" (la lista de la Sección 8 del condado también sigue cerrada). Su portal de inscripción añade: "MULTIFAMILY PROGRAM WAITING LISTS ARE NOW CLOSED!" (las listas del programa multifamiliar están cerradas). Verificado el 21 de septiembre de 2026.

waitlists.program: Apartamentos asequibles de propiedad privada en Long Beach
waitlists.note: HACLB publica un listado de vivienda asequible de propiedad privada y dice: "Each facility maintains its own independent waiting list" (cada edificio mantiene su propia lista de espera) y "You may register on as many waiting lists as you wish" (puede inscribirse en todas las listas que quiera). Usted solicita a cada edificio directamente; HACLB no recibe esas solicitudes ni puede decirle su posición en ellas.

also_serving: La Los Angeles County Development Authority (LACDA) es una agencia aparte, y Long Beach queda fuera de casi todo su territorio a propósito. LACDA dice que sirve a "the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County (areas that are not part of a city) and 62 incorporated cities" (las zonas no incorporadas del condado y 62 ciudades incorporadas), y nombra a Long Beach como una de las 18 ciudades del condado que tienen su propia agencia de vivienda. Línea principal (626) 262-4511.

La única excepción es Carmelitos, y es una excepción grande. LACDA declara que tiene un "Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Long Beach Housing Authority to permit residents of the City of Long Beach to be classified as in-jurisdiction applicants for housing at the Carmelitos Public Housing development only": un acuerdo que permite a los residentes de Long Beach contar como solicitantes locales, únicamente para Carmelitos. Carmelitos está en Long Beach, y sus dos listas por sitio cubren 155 unidades para personas mayores y 558 unidades familiares. Esas listas estuvieron abiertas del 17 de agosto al 16 de septiembre de 2026 y ahora están cerradas. La página principal de HACLB sí publicó un aviso sobre la apertura del condado, "Los Angeles County Public Housing Waiting List is Open. Applications accepted 8/17/2026 - 9/16/2026" (la lista de vivienda pública del condado está abierta; solicitudes del 17 de agosto al 16 de septiembre de 2026), pero no nombra a Carmelitos, así que consulte lacda.org para la próxima apertura.

HUD va a terminar el programa Emergency Housing Voucher. La página principal de HACLB dice: "The U.S. Department of Housing of Urban Development has notified us that they are ending the Emergency Housing Voucher program" (HUD nos notificó que va a terminar el programa). A HACLB le habían asignado 582 de estos vales bajo la Ley del Plan de Rescate Estadounidense. Si usted tiene uno, llame a HACLB al (562) 570-6985 y pregunte qué significa el cierre del programa para su hogar en lugar de esperar una carta.

HACLB atiende solo con cita. Su oficina en 1500 Hughes Way, Suite C-300 abre lunes, martes, miércoles y viernes de 7:30 a.m. a 4:00 p.m. y jueves de 7:30 a.m. a 2:00 p.m., y le pide que programe una cita por adelantado llamando al (562) 570-6985. Hay un buzón disponible de lunes a viernes de 4:30 a.m. a 7:00 p.m., y el correo para asuntos de la lista de espera es HA-WaitingList@longbeach.gov.

faqs.q: ¿Está abierta la lista de espera de la Sección 8 de Long Beach?
faqs.a: No. Al 21 de septiembre de 2026, la Autoridad de Vivienda de la Ciudad de Long Beach declara que su lista de espera "is currently closed, and no openings are scheduled at this time" (está cerrada y no hay aperturas programadas). No hay fecha anunciada de reapertura. HACLB dice que lo anunciará en su sitio web y en sus redes sociales, y su página de solicitud ofrece una lista de correo para avisarle. Confirme en longbeach.gov/haclb/apply o llame al (562) 570-6985 antes de dar esto por seguro.

No a través de HACLB. El informe de contactos de PHA de HUD clasifica a la City of Long Beach Housing Authority (CA068) como programa de "Section 8", y las páginas de programas de HACLB solo enumeran programas basados en vales. Pero Carmelitos, una comunidad grande de vivienda pública dentro de Long Beach, pertenece a la Los Angeles County Development Authority. Sus listas para personas mayores y para familias estuvieron abiertas del 17 de agosto al 16 de septiembre de 2026 y ahora están cerradas: la página de LACDA dice "The waiting list application period closed on September 16, 2026, at 5:00 p.m." (el período de solicitud cerró el 16 de septiembre de 2026 a las 5:00 p.m.; verificado el 21 de septiembre de 2026). Si busca vivienda pública en Long Beach, Carmelitos sigue siendo el lugar que conviene vigilar, y LACDA no ha dado fecha para la próxima apertura.

faqs.q: ¿Puedo solicitar Carmelitos si vivo en Long Beach?
faqs.a: Sí, cada vez que LACDA abra las listas de Carmelitos, y le tratan como solicitante local. LACDA declara que tiene un acuerdo con la autoridad de vivienda de Long Beach "to permit residents of the City of Long Beach to be classified as in-jurisdiction applicants for housing at the Carmelitos Public Housing development only" (para que los residentes de Long Beach cuenten como solicitantes dentro de la jurisdicción, únicamente para Carmelitos). La inscripción más reciente fue del 17 de agosto al 16 de septiembre de 2026 y ya cerró; el portal de inscripción de LACDA, harp.lacda.org, ahora dice "ALL PUBLIC HOUSING WAITING LISTS ARE NOW CLOSED" (todas las listas de vivienda pública están cerradas; verificado el 21 de septiembre de 2026). Para preguntas, llame a LACDA al (626) 586-1522.

faqs.q: ¿A qué número debo llamar en la autoridad de vivienda de Long Beach?
faqs.a: Al (562) 570-6985. Es el número de la página de contacto de HACLB y el que HUD registra para CA068, y HACLB le pide que lo use para pedir una cita antes de ir en persona. Varios equipos tienen sus propias líneas directas: mudanzas y portabilidad (562) 570-5242, aumentos de renta y dueños (562) 570-5372, e inspecciones (562) 570-5340. Tenga en cuenta que el (562) 570-4500 que aparece en la página de inicio de la autoridad pertenece a los servicios de vivienda y personas sin hogar de la ciudad, no a HACLB.

faqs.q: Tengo un Emergency Housing Voucher. ¿Qué pasa ahora?
faqs.a: HACLB publicó que "The U.S. Department of Housing of Urban Development has notified us that they are ending the Emergency Housing Voucher program" (HUD notificó que va a terminar el programa) y remite a longbeach.gov/ehv para más detalles. HACLB recibió 582 de estos vales bajo la Ley del Plan de Rescate Estadounidense. HACLB no ha publicado un calendario para cada hogar, así que llame al (562) 570-6985 y pregunte concretamente qué significa el fin del programa para su asistencia y su contrato de arrendamiento, y pida la respuesta por escrito.

faqs.q: ¿Cómo me entero de cuándo reabre la lista de HACLB?
faqs.a: HACLB dice que lo anunciará en su sitio web y en sus redes sociales, y su página de solicitud ofrece una inscripción a su lista de correo. Como la reapertura no está programada, conviene ponerse un recordatorio propio para revisar longbeach.gov/haclb cada pocas semanas en vez de esperar a verlo. Mientras tanto, los edificios asequibles de propiedad privada del listado de HACLB mantienen cada uno su propia lista a la que puede inscribirse en cualquier momento. Las listas de vivienda pública de Carmelitos que el condado de Los Ángeles abrió el 17 de agosto de 2026 cerraron el 16 de septiembre de 2026.
